easyPrerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Abdel Adrian, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
